Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one wide 16:9 2D pixel-art gameplay screenshot for an article about Eoul, a bright Korean folklore game world.
Primary request: Actual gameplay of a careful controlled-demolition job simulator. The player sees current load, places two temporary braces, connects rope, removes safe wooden pins, cuts one stuck joint at a value cost, and lowers a valuable roof part without collapsing an old consenting hanok.
Scene/backdrop: cutaway side view inside an old Korean timber house, roof tiles partly removed, visible posts, lintel and joinery, dust in afternoon light.
Subject: one worker uses a pry bar on one highlighted safe wooden pin. Exactly two braces support the lintel. One decorative chest and one roof panel are secured by ropes; a subtle friendly house-spirit glow rests in the central beam. Colored load arrows transfer into the braces.
Composition/framing: side-on actual game view. Main structure center. Left tool belt has exactly four icons: brace, pry bar, hand saw, rope. Top compact load gauge. Right contract checklist uses three object icons: carved lintel, painted chest, roof tile stack. Dashed lowering arc to a safe zone. Highlight only one removable pin.
Style/medium: crisp detailed 16-bit pixel art, square pixels, aged warm wood, blue-gray tiles, amber spirit glow, functional dark UI.
Lighting/mood: careful craft tension, not destruction spectacle or horror.
Text (verbatim): LOAD 71, BRACE, UNPIN, CUT, LOWER.
Constraints: safe removal order and load transfer are central. No cleaning, repair diagnosis, explosives, wrecking ball, terrain artillery, ship buoyancy, carrying minigame, grid puzzle, combat, logo, watermark, or poster. Opaque full-bleed landscape.
visual_qa: 정확히 두 버팀대와 하중 화살표, LOAD 71, 선택한 UNPIN 결합 확인
버팀대·핀 빼기·절단·밧줄 네 도구와 밧줄로 묶인 지붕판·문갑 확인

items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one wide 16:9 2D pixel-art gameplay screenshot for an article about Eoul, a bright Korean folklore game world.
Primary request: Show the actual playable desktop-companion exact-count incremental game. A tiny counting spirit lives along the bottom of a fictional computer desktop. Every 30 seconds anonymous activity becomes one indivisible counting bead worth 1, 2 or 3. The player routes each bead to boards with exact capacities 3, 5 and 7; exact boards auto-lock; then chooses permanent CLOSE or temporary COMPOUND.
Scene/backdrop: clean fictional desktop with one neutral work window containing abstract blocks only, no readable private content. Bottom third is a Korean paper-ledger game strip.
Subject: one tiny friendly counting spirit arranges glowing beans and knotted cords. The 3-board contains a bead 2 plus bead 1 and is visibly AUTO LOCKED. The 5-board contains bead 2 with three spaces remaining. The 7-board is empty. Show indivisible bead tokens clearly.
Composition/framing: actual desktop game UI. Left has anonymous counters with keyboard, mouse and hourglass icons plus numbers only and a privacy shield. Center has arrows into boards 3, 5, 7. Right has two choices: rising spiral COMPOUND +1 and closed ledger CLOSE, with a permanent charm preview. Keep all private work content abstract.
Style/medium: crisp charming 16-bit pixel art, square pixels, Korean paper and ink textures, soft indigo desktop, warm gold counters, functional compact UI.
Lighting/mood: unobtrusive, satisfying, quietly magical.
Text (verbatim): 3, 5, 7, AUTO LOCKED, COMPOUND +1, CLOSE, TOTALS ONLY.
Constraints: never show typed words, messages, filenames, browser history, or personal content. No loot boxes, combat, factory belts, logistics, auto-battle, cards, logo, watermark, or poster. Opaque full-bleed landscape.
visual_qa: 3판의 2+1 정확수와 AUTO LOCKED, 5판의 2와 세 빈칸, 빈 7판 확인
TOTALS ONLY와 키보드·마우스·시간 숫자, 개인정보 없는 추상 작업창 확인
COMPOUND +1과 CLOSE가 별도 선택이며 물류·전투·확률형 보상 없음 확인
